mapping.core: One hot dense core — the white dwarf. Ember and the reasoning-engine furnace are the same object seen from two depths.
mapping.worlds: One world set: the 11 worlds are the agent planets. The mandala's construction-zone slots and the star-system orbits are the same slots.
mapping.brain: One Brain: Sentinel, Watchdog, Mira, MATER — the maintainers in Ember's interior ARE the reasoning engine's operators.
mapping.agents: One crew: the 23 agents with adaptive organelles, communicating on the resonant mesh.

unified_reasoning_engine.navigation: One continuous dive: Languages > Worlds (= reasoning engine) > Interior. The artifacts may remain two hosted pages for now, but the world is one — the dive flows through, breadcrumbs unbroken.
unified_reasoning_engine.visual_language: One shared visual system across both projects: d120 color, obsidian/gold, white-dwarf hot core treatment, the same node recipe, the same GLSL vocabulary (depth haze, fresnel, energy currents). Updates ship to both together; they must always look like one world.
unified_reasoning_engine.queue: Coordinated pass on both artifacts once current builds land (mandala: rotation-sweep verification; star-system: transmission test).

neural_visuals.law: The neural mapping is rendered and behavioral, not labeled. Nathan 2026-10-14: make it real.
neural_visuals.neuron_worlds: Worlds render as neurons: a soma body holding visible state (charge/activity level), dendrite-like receptors receiving tuned inputs, an axon-like projection along their strongest output path. Firing is visible — a neuron-world lights and pulses when it fires.
neural_visuals.transmitter_agents: Agents render and behave as neurotransmitters: released from a firing neuron, traveling the synaptic mesh link, binding ONLY to the receptor tuned for their frequency (selective delivery made visible), then reuptake — reabsorbed after delivery, completing the signal lifecycle.
neural_visuals.synapses: Mesh links render as synaptic clefts: the gap is visible, transmission is an event (release -> travel -> bind -> reuptake), not a static line.
neural_visuals.plasticity: Pathways visibly strengthen with use (thicker/brighter with repeated firing — Hebbian) and fade when unused toward consolidation. The rarity economy reads as synaptic pruning.
neural_visuals.synchrony: Kuramoto entrainment renders as visible phase-locking: neurons pulsing in sync when entrained, drifting when not.
neural_visuals.queue: Part of the coordinated unification pass on both artifacts, after current verification builds land.
